cc:Work.dc:title: Local langbench Mandelbrot runtime
cc:Work.dc:description:
Local single-thread langbench Mandelbrot trial; not an official Docker campaign.
Fresh processes, one external warmup per cell/profile, no in-program warmup. The unchanged C reference includes pthread spawn/join and an atomic row queue; the scalar Goose port has neither. This trial makes no parallel runtime claims.
